summary: Iteration 5 — Parent username+password login (replacing OTP) tested end-to-end. Backend: wrote 23 pytest cases in test_iteration5.py — 22 passed, 1 skipped (no legacy-parent-without-username currently exists; the 'already set' branch is covered). Verified: POST /auth/parent/login (anjali.reddy/Parent@123 works, ANJALI.REDDY is case-insensitive, wrong pwd/unknown user both return generic 401 'Invalid username or password', 5 wrong attempts → 429 with lockout message, deactivated parent → 403); OTP endpoints /auth/parent/send-otp and /verify-otp return 404; POST /students with parent_username/password (duplicate username → 409 'already taken', password <6 chars → 400 '…at least 6…', sibling with same parent_phone reuses the existing login — no creds needed, admin cannot create a parent login → 403); GET /parents/lookup?phone=… returns exists/username/name; GET /users/username-available?username=… correctly reports available/taken; POST /users/{id}/parent-login 400 when already set (legacy path skipped — no legacy parent exists); POST /users/{id}/reset-password with new_password revokes old token (/auth/me returns 401), old pwd rejected, new pwd works, requires new_password (400 if omitted for parent), staff reset with no body still returns temp_password (10-char). GET /students for MD includes parent_has_login and parent_username. Frontend (mobile 390x844): /auth/parent-login has parent-username-input, parent-password-input, parent-toggle-pwd, parent-login-btn, parent-forgot-btn; wrong creds show error toast; anjali.reddy / Parent@123 → navigates to /parent/home (full welcome screen with Elthea GROW profile loaded). /auth/parent-forgot shows parent-fp-message 'Please contact the school office. The MD will reset your password.' MD login → /admin/students: add-student-btn opens modal with all testIDs including add-parent-username and add-parent-password; typing phone 9876543210 shows existing-login-box 'Existing login: anjali.reddy'. No setlogin-<id> chips present (all 13 seeded parents already have logins — expected). /admin/users: filter-parent → tap a parent card → reset-pwd-btn visible → opens parent-new-password + confirm-parent-reset → parent-reset-done confirmation shown with 'Password updated. Old sessions were signed out.' Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Pre-existing RN Web warnings observed (shadow* props deprecated, pointerEvents deprecated, expo-notifications on web).
action_items: (INFO) The /users/{id}/parent-login legacy-parent path is covered by code review + the '400 if already set' test, but no runtime assertion that a legacy parent (no username) can be upgraded was possible — the current DB has 13 parents, all with usernames. If the main agent wants coverage, seed a parent via direct Mongo insert without 'username', or expose a dev-only endpoint. Not blocking.
(INFO) The staff-login screen uses testIDs email-input / password-input / login-btn (not staff-email-input etc). Not an issue, just a note for future testing scripts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2100 lines; parent-login + reset + lookup live alongside everything else. Still fine but splitting into auth.py / users.py / students.py modules becomes more urgent each iteration.
parent_login() does a constant-time bcrypt against DUMMY_HASH when the user is unknown — good timing-attack mitigation. Nice.

login_attempts uses an identifier like 'parent:<lowercased-username>' and both increments and clears via the same path — reset-password endpoint explicitly deletes the attempt record so a legitimate owner is unlocked immediately after reset. Good.
reset_user_password: increments token_version only when a reset actually happens (both branches), and the parent branch mandates new_password. Correct behaviour.
ensure_username_free scans both username and email collisions — avoids a parent accidentally shadowing a staff email. Good defensive check.

create_student: when parent already has a username, incoming parent_username/parent_password are silently ignored (no 400). This is intentional for sibling re-use and matches the spec. Confirmed by test_sibling_reuses_existing_parent_login.
seed_data_creation: Created ~15 TEST_-prefixed parents and students during pytest (phones 72000xxxxx, usernames qa.* / lock.* / deact.* / dup.* / sib.* / adm.* / lu.* / taken.* / have.* / rst.* / req.*). Also: during UI test I changed anjali.reddy's password to 'ResetTest@123' then restored it back to 'Parent@123' via /users/{id}/reset-password so the test credential file stays accurate. Backend was NOT restarted (per main agent note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL: read from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Iteration 5 endpoints: POST /api/auth/parent/login {username,password}; POST /api/students now accepts parent_username+parent_password (required when parent_phone has no existing login; MD-only — admin 403 for new parent logins); POST /api/students for a known parent_phone silently reuses existing login (no creds needed); POST /api/users/{id}/parent-login for legacy parents without usernames (400 if already set); POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password body {new_password} for parents revokes old token and rotates password; staff reset with no body still returns temp_password. GET /api/parents/lookup?phone= and GET /api/users/username-available?username= available to MD/admin and MD respectively. OTP endpoints are gone (404). GET /api/students for MD includes parent_has_login + parent_username. Frontend testIDs: /auth/parent-login → parent-username-input, parent-password-input, parent-toggle-pwd, parent-login-btn, parent-forgot-btn; /auth/parent-forgot → parent-fp-message; /admin/students Add Student → add-parent-username, add-parent-password, existing-login-box; setlogin-<id> chip + modal (setlogin-username, setlogin-password, confirm-set-login); /admin/users → reset-pwd-btn, parent-new-password, confirm-parent-reset, parent-reset-done. Staff login screen uses email-input/password-input/login-btn (not staff-prefixed).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only observation: no 'legacy' parent (one without a username) exists in the seeded DB so the happy-path of POST /users/{id}/parent-login was not run end-to-end against a real user; the 400-if-already-set branch and the ensure_username_free helper + validate_new_password were exercised, giving high confidence the endpoint works.
